title: Testing strong exogeneity in proxy SVARs with internal synthetic proxies
abstract: arXiv:2610.36093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proxy SVARs often rely on a single credible proxy, leaving proxy exogeneity untestable. Narrative arguments used to justify proxy validity imply a stronger form of exogeneity. We formalize the strong exogeneity assumption and propose a corresponding test based on internal synthetic proxies. The approach uses the external proxy to locate the target-shock direction in the reduced-form innovations and synthesize the candidate shock into an additional internal synthetic proxies, which allows to test the joint exogeneity of the original and internal synthetic proxy. We derive the large-sample theory for the ISP test and show that the identification strength is governed by a direct measure of the target shock's non-Gaussianity. We study weak identification under asymptotic Gaussianity and develop an identification-robust version of the test. translated_title: 基于内部合成工具变量的代理SVAR强外生性检验
translated_abstract: 代理SVAR（结构向量自回归模型）通常依赖单一可信的外部工具变量，导致工具变量的外生性无法检验。用于论证代理变量有效性的叙述性论据实际上蕴含着一种更强的外生性形式。本文将强外生性假设形式化，并提出基于内部合成工具变量（ISP）的相应检验方法。该方法利用外部工具变量在简化式新息中定位目标冲击的方向，并将候选冲击合成为一个额外的内部合成工具变量，从而能够对原始工具变量与内部合成工具变量进行联合外生性检验。我们推导了ISP检验的大样本理论，并证明识别强度由目标冲击非高斯性的直接度量所决定。我们研究了渐近高斯情形下的弱识别问题，并开发了一种识别稳健版本的检验方法。蒙特卡洛实验表明，当工具变量信噪比较低时，该检验具有良好的检验功效。
tldr: 本文提出基于内部合成工具变量的强外生性检验方法，解决了代理SVAR中单一工具变量外生性无法检验的问题，并推导了识别强度由目标冲击非高斯性决定的大样本理论及识别稳健检验版本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an internal synthetic proxy test for strong exogeneity in proxy SVARs, overcoming the untestability of proxy exogeneity with a single proxy, with large-sample theory showing identification strength is governed by the target shock's non-Gaussianity, plus an identification-robust version.
